_comment: Front-server notice content (handlers/utils.ts noticeGameJson / receiveOnlyJson). 'notice' feeds the client's notice_game state (MFG.GameData/NoticeGameData.cs -> HomeNoticeWindow / NoticeCarouselBanner); 'important' feeds receive_only.ImportantNotices (ReceiveOnlyGameData.cs -> HomeFlow.ImportantNoticeAppearance -> ImportantNoticeWindow). 'category' accepts a MFG.Types.Notice.Category name or its int. An id the account has acked (notice_done / important_notice_done) is never served again. 'home_display' true + a home_display_end in the future makes the notice a home carousel banner AND a forced-display modal, so home_banner must name a banner asset the client build actually has; leave both empty to publish a plain list entry. 'important' ids must be MFG.Types.ImportantNotice.NoticeID members (Manner=1, Nuisance=2) - ImportantNoticeWindow finds its page by that name and skips ids its master does not have.

notice.title: Server build notes
notice.text:
Self-hosted front server.

- Matching, event tables, gacha, Spirit Gym, records and stamps are served by this server.
- Notices, missions and event schedules are configured in the plugin data files.

Read the notices once: an acknowledged notice is never sent again.

notice.title: Daily bonus
notice.text: One daily login bonus present is granted per JST day and lands in the present box automatically.

notice.title: Costume additions unlocked
notice.text: Every CostumeAddition event is declared active, so costume unlocks show in My Room without a dated schedule behind them.
